summary_1line: Lomasa recounts how Rama (Vishnu’s avatar) humbled Parashurama, who later regained his lost energy through penance at a sacred river.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama, son of Dasaratha, effortlessly strings the celestial bow and its thunderous twang frightens all creatures.
Parashurama gazes into Rama’s body and beholds gods, stars, rivers, mountains, and the Vedas contained within him.
The blazing arrow released by Rama shakes the earth with thunder, meteors, dust storms, and quaking ground.
